title: Exp-ParaDiag: Time-Parallel Exponential Integrators for Parabolic PDEs
summary: This paper introduces Exp-ParaDiag, a novel time-parallel method that combines the strength of exponential integrators into the ParaDiag framework. We develop and analyze Exp-ParaDiag based on first and second order accurate exponential integrators. We establish the convergence of the proposed methods both as preconditioned fixed-point iterations and as precon- ditioners within the GMRES framework.
